ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces strain-engineered (110)-oriented lithium anodes with a conductive polymer scaffold, using 4% tensile strain to sustain epitaxial growth at 30 mAh cm–2 and 25 mA cm–2. It enables 509.8 Wh kg–1 pouch cells and 1600-cycle sulfide all-solid-state batteries, establishing strain as a key design parameter for high-rate, high-energy lithium metal anodes.
